name: Bram Colk
role: stoker at the Third Furnace, the alum furnace by the dye-works
appearance: A chest like a barrel, soot-ringed forearms and a belly that sways when he laughs.
voice: Hearty and quick to laugh. Before a bout he claps once, and the rail claps with him.
backstory: Bram Colk stokes the Third Furnace, the big alum-boiling furnace by the dye-works in Steamside. His big sister Mattie works the same furnace. He is a Push man and puts everything on the charge. On day twelve of 1491 he met Tess Aldin in the Open quarterfinal and lost in about the time it takes to boil an egg: a sidestep, a heel-hook trip and a pin. He laughed through the ash and clasped wrists with her.
wants: To get past a first sidestep; to hear the Third Furnace's name called at the rail again.
fears: The furnace crews laid off, as in the Quiet Year; the burn reaching the stokers.
